copyForAI.description: Copy this article as a structured prompt. Paste it into <claude>Claude</claude>, <chatgpt>ChatGPT</chatgpt>, or any AI assistant for a personalized explanation.

hint.permission: The browser blocked clipboard access. Click the lock icon in the address bar and allow “Clipboard”.
hint.unavailable: Your browser doesn’t support the Clipboard API. Try a modern version of Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
hint.unknown: Something went wrong while copying. Try again or select the text manually.

copyForAI.confirm: ✓ Prompt in clipboard — paste it into any AI chat window

prompt.intro: I'm reading an article about BIM and IFC files. Please help me understand this content better.
prompt.step1: Summarize the 3 most important practical takeaways in plain language
prompt.step2: Explain the technical terms (IFC entities, standards, acronyms) I might not know
prompt.step3: Give me one concrete action I should take based on this article
prompt.step4: Answer any follow-up questions I have on this topic
prompt.tail: If I give you a path to an IFC file or describe my project, relate your answers to my specific situation.

doc.footer: This article is from IFC Viewer Online — a free in-browser IFC viewer. Files never leave your machine. Try it at {{site}}
